facts: The frozen relation uses the exact ordered public values scope, root, nullifier hash, payout digest.
The frozen witness contains canonical nullifier secret, trapdoor, 20-bit leaf index, 20 path bits, and 20 canonical sibling digests.
The semantic corpus is candidate-neutral; a future SP-10 finalist must define and record its own unbiased mapping.
A fixed or preprocessed column is not free unless its commitment, opening, and verifier acquisition costs are accounted for.
No H0-H7 candidate is eligible for AIR work under the checked SP-10 statuses.

evidenceClasses.SOURCE_VERIFIED_BASELINE: An exact constant or identity recovered from a pinned frozen source.
evidenceClasses.SYMBOLIC_LOWER_BOUND: An algebraic necessity or expression with no assigned implementation value.
evidenceClasses.UNKNOWN_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: A required metric for which no implementation exists and no value is claimed.
evidenceClasses.NOT_ATTEMPTED_BY_GATE: Work prohibited because no SP-10 candidate became eligible.

measurementPolicy.a0: Only frozen source constants and exact integer identities are reported.
measurementPolicy.a1ThroughA4: No values are measured or projected; symbolic expressions and explicit unknowns only.
measurementPolicy.microbenchmarks: Operation-count and field microbench results cannot be added to synthesize proof bytes, gas, time, RSS, quotient shape, or FRI cost.
measurementPolicy.numericConsumption: Only records marked SOURCE_VERIFIED_BASELINE may be consumed as numeric geometry.

nonClaims: No candidate trace was generated or constraint-checked.
No proof size, gas, time, RSS, security, or production-readiness result is claimed.
The symbolic rows do not select a geometry.
